title: Workspace scope, storage paths and single lifecycle owner

tests.name: test/contracts/workspace-scope.test.js
tests.detail: sourceRoot/stateRoot separation, cross-process lock refusal, dead-holder reclaim, canonical alias collapse

findings: Ownership is enforced across processes by an on-disk lock carrying the holder pid with a liveness check, not only in memory.
Canonical aliases (symlinks, macOS /var versus /private/var) resolve to one owner.
Construction starts no watcher and no auto-index.
knownLimitations: The runtime is implemented and tested but is not yet the gate in front of the derived indexes; src/index-manager.js remains the lifecycle owner on the query path in both engine modes, which is what keeps the two readers from racing.
rollback: The module is not on the default query path; removing it changes no behaviour.
